data: one real UK Biobank resting-state BOLD; aggregate statistics only
inputs: the same confound-regressed BOLD, T1w surfaces, cortex masks, MNI volume, TemplateFlow labels and HCP dseg; sphere comparison changes only native-to-fsLR registration

fnit_pytorch_msmsulc_vs_official_msm_sph.only_variable: registered sphere; other volume, surfaces, masks, templates and Workbench commands fixed

msmsulc_cause_diagnostic.official_config: NMI affine, then three correlation-based discrete levels; icosahedral control/data grids and higher-order strain regularization
msmsulc_cause_diagnostic.fnit_optimizer: four graph-smoothed squared-error stages, continuous Adam, fixed Fibonacci control points, edge/area penalties
msmsulc_cause_diagnostic.interpretation: The only changed projection input was the registration sphere. Greater FNIT-to-official spherical displacement is strongly associated with lower per-grayordinate temporal correlation. FNIT matches the sulcal metric more closely under this diagnostic yet distorts edges more; that does not establish better anatomical correspondence.

limits: Workbench stage times are summed from separate runs, not a full fMRIPrep wall time. Upstream BBR, MNI registration and denoising differ from fMRIPrep. The default FNIT MSMSulc sphere is not numerically equivalent to official MSM.
